title: Actual-processor first-live-Jam replay conditions, fixture truth and metrics
frozen_before: any replay measurement or replay evidence inference
purpose: Replay the real GuitarCompanionProcessor callback and the frozen submitJamCommand/readJamLiveState facade under a fixed conditions matrix, so the first live-Jam slice has actual-processor callback-allocation/lock/overhead and audio-clock semantics evidence. Synthetic fixtures are not guitar recordings.

matrix.warm_blocks_rule: round(target_seconds * rate / block), clamped to [16, 200000]; --warm-blocks overrides
notes: enabled_pressure is the intentional offline fast-loop starvation/queue-pressure cell; it is separate from the realtime paced enabled cells and never claims worker/clock receipt.
4096 is above the 2048 analysis tap chunk ceiling, so it exercises oversized-callback chunking and remainder handling.
disabled is the control condition: the pipeline is not started but the attached bridge may still be serviced by the processor; the control does not claim a zero-overhead baseline.

backend.description: The accepted merged pipeline's explicit live backend. Builds without a live backend must report unavailable and reject Start; the harness then records enabled cells unmeasured and exits 3.

callback_alloc.zero_test: alloc_cxx_total == cxx_new + cxx_new_array + cxx_new_nothrow + cxx_new_aligned; alloc_c_total == c_malloc + c_calloc + c_realloc; each cannot undercount the plain forms

callback_free.note: noop_frees is free(NULL), a defined no-op, counted apart from heap frees

timing.claim: instrumented wall time around the armed callback, not CPU time, not a latency gate

rules: audioSampleTime advances by exactly one block per callback, including while Jam is stopped
receipt timestamps are block-resolution only: no sub-block receipt or measured device latency is claimed

silence_enabled.note: The shipped MusicalClock publishes its configured fallbackBpm while no belief exists. That is an explicit fallback, not tracker-derived tempo; the no-fabrication signal is no lock and no confidence.
silence_enabled.reason: no observation can lock the clock from silence; the clock advances from the audio cursor without acquiring a belief

disabled.reason: no Start is submitted in the control cells

fixtures.sample_exact_checksum: sha256 of the little-endian int16 sample stream as written, independent of WAV container metadata
fixtures.reason_generated_outside_git: keep the repository free of waveform binaries; the manifest records identity and the sample-exact checksum for cross-checking

required_backend_signals: a live backend indicator (experimentalBTrack symbol or a JAM/BTRACK build define) in the product build
required_identity: source src tree hash (committed tree + working-tree content; HEAD is not assumed clean)
fail_closed.detect_product_wrong_source: the product build.ninja include path for the source tree must equal --source; otherwise the harness refuses to link a stale header against a differently-built archive
fail_closed.on_missing_live: write an awaiting-product receipt naming the missing items, do not invoke any existing binary, exit 3 (never report a stale archive as clean)

in_scope: actual-processor callback allocation/free/lock counters for the tap/pipeline
audio sample-clock advance and stopped-state advance semantics
join/stop/resync/reprepare/reset command acceptance and state transitions
callback overhead contrast disabled vs enabled at the same block/rate/input
oversized 4096 callback chunking and remainder behaviour
out_of_scope: physical audio device, ASIO and latency deadlines
